newsitem.title: USA: Delta,Continental apparently end merge talks-paper.
newsitem.headline: Delta,Continental apparently end merge talks-paper.

text.p: Talk of a merger between Delta Air Lines Inc and Continental Airlines appears to have ended with no deal in sight, the Atlanta Journal-Constitution reported on Sunday.

The newspaper said Continental Chairman Gordon Bethune told employees in a telephone message taped late on Friday that the company had held "very preliminary discussions" with several airlines recently.
"Right now, we do not have any discussions nor do we have a plan to have any discussions," he was quoted as saying in the recorded message.
The newpaper said Bethune also recommended that it was "time to probably put this all behind us" and that, for now, "to do nothing is probably the best thing for us."
The Continental executive never mentioned Delta, which was named in news reports earlier this month as having received a merger proposal from the Houston-based carrier.
A Delta spokesman declined to comment on Bethune's remarks, maintaining the airline's refusal to confirm or deny that talks were ever held.
